_readme: Provenance registry. Every numeric parameter in crops.json / techniques.json / infrastructure.json / scenarios.json / defaults.json references one entry here via its 'src' key. type is one of: official_dataset | scientific_model | open_dataset | user_supplied | prototype_assumption.

fao56.name: FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56 - Crop evapotranspiration (Allen et al., 1998), Tables 11-12
fao56.note: Kc values and stage lengths transcribed by the developer from the publication; re-check against the tables before relying on them.

fao29.name: FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 29 rev.1 - Water quality for agriculture (Ayers & Westcot), Table 4 (Maas-Hoffman salinity thresholds)
fao29.note: ECe threshold and slope transcribed from the publication; re-check before relying on them.

qatar_od_crops.name: State of Qatar Open Data - Production Area and Average Yield of Crops (open field)
qatar_od_crops.note: Retrieved at run time through the Opendatasoft API. Records whose reported yield disagrees with production/area are rejected (see adapter).

qatar_od_greenhouse.name: State of Qatar Open Data - Cropped area & production of crops in greenhouses
qatar_od_greenhouse.note: Greenhouse yield = production / cropped area. Covers tomato, cucumber and sweet pepper only.

aquacrop.name: FAO AquaCrop (aquacrop Python package 3.1.0), built-in Tomato crop file
aquacrop.note: Applied to open-field tomato only: the only MVP crop with a calibrated crop file shipped with AquaCrop.

proto_temp.name: Typical agronomic temperature limits (developer estimate, not cultivar specific)
proto_temp.note: Used only to decide which months a crop can be grown. Replace with cultivar-specific limits.

proto_cycle.name: Crop cycle length, cycles-per-year cap and inputs cost (developer estimate)
proto_cycle.note: Order-of-magnitude values pending a Qatar agronomist review.

proto_price.name: Farm-gate selling price (developer estimate; no Qatar price dataset integrated)
proto_price.note: Users are expected to overwrite these with their own prices.

proto_yield.name: Controlled-environment yield per cycle (order of magnitude from published ranges; not verified for Qatar)
proto_yield.note: Used where no Qatar Open Data / AquaCrop value exists (soilless systems, greenhouse lettuce/strawberry).

proto_capex.name: Capital cost per m2 and fixed items (developer estimate; no supplier quotes)

proto_opex.name: Annual operating cost excluding energy and water (developer estimate)

proto_energy.name: Electricity use per m2 (developer estimate)
proto_energy.note: Cooling, lighting, pumping. Seasonal shape is derived from NASA POWER temperatures.

proto_water.name: Water coefficient relative to open-field crop water demand (developer estimate)
proto_water.note: Relative to FAO-56 ETc / AquaCrop irrigation; recirculating systems use less.

proto_infra.name: Shared infrastructure fixed cost (developer estimate)
proto_infra.note: Paid once per plot no matter how many production systems use it.

proto_tariff.name: Electricity and water unit prices (developer estimate; verify with the Kahramaa tariff)
proto_tariff.note: Not verified against the current Kahramaa tariff.

proto_scenario.name: Scenario multipliers (definition of the what-if, not a forecast)

proto_limits.name: Solver planning defaults (peak factor, access share, utilisation floor)
proto_limits.note: Modelling choices exposed in the UI.

user.name: User supplied
user.note: Entered by the user in the interface.
